system.notes:
Anemoi that embodies one of the cardinal winds. High- ranking, speaks for the gods.

AC 19, HP 68, ATK 4 spear (close/near) +9 (2d6) or 4 lightning blast (far) +9 (2d10) and cardinal wind, MV far (fly), S +3, D +5, C +5, I +4, W +4, Ch +5, AL N, LV 14

Cardinal Wind. Has one of the following powers: North. Flames, one creature within far, immolated for 2d6 damage. South. Icy blast, straight line (5' wide) extending double near, DEX 15+ or 2d4 DEX damage. East. One creature within far, misfortune, WIS 15+ or DISADV for 1d4 rounds. West. Soothing wind, all within double near, CHA 15+ to take hostile actions against anemoi or allies.

Impervious. Unless in contact with dirt or earth, only damaged by magical sources.

Regenerate. Unless in contact with dirt or earth, regains 2d6 HP on its turn.

Wind Form. Unless in contact with dirt or earth, turn into wind.
